name: base descriptor bypasses subtype override
source:
events = []
class Items(list):
    def sort(self, **kwargs):
        events.append('override')
        return 42
    def __iter__(self):
        raise AssertionError('must use list payload')
items = Items([3, 1, 2])
assert items.sort() == 42
assert list.sort(items) is None
assert list.__getitem__(items, 0) == 1
assert list.__getitem__(items, 1) == 2
assert list.__getitem__(items, 2) == 3
observation = events
expected: ['override']

name: truth then keys with temporary empty payload
key failure preserves identity and original payload
mutation during reverse precedes sorting
source:
items = [3, 1, 2]
class Reverse:
    def __bool__(self):
        items.append(4)
        return True
result = list.sort(items, reverse=Reverse())
observation = (result, items)

name: mutation during key raises after restoring sorted payload
expected: ('ValueError', 'list modified during sort', [1, 2, 3])

name: stable reverse sorting retains member identities
source:
class Item:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
a = Item(1)
b = Item(1)
c = Item(2)
items = [a,b,c]
list.sort(items, key=lambda item:item.value, reverse=True)
observation = (items[0] is c, items[1] is a, items[2] is b)
expected: (True, True, True)
